Overview

A closer look

The Enterprise Security Audit is a professional assessment engagement that pairs automated scanning with expert analysis. You receive a clear picture of your current security posture and a prioritized, board-ready remediation roadmap.

Every audit is scoped up front with defined objectives, frameworks, and deliverables — so you know exactly what will be assessed and what you will receive.

Capabilities

What you get

🔍

Automated Assessment

Broad, repeatable scans across infrastructure, applications and configurations.

📊

Gap Analysis

Compare current controls against NIST AI RMF, ISO 27001, SOC 2 and EU AI Act requirements.

🧾

Remediation Roadmap

Findings are triaged by risk with clear, prioritized actions and owner guidance.

🎯

Expert Review

Security specialists validate findings and remove false positives before reporting.

📄

Board-Ready Report

Executive summary plus technical annexes your board and auditors can rely on.

🔁

Re-Audit Option

Schedule periodic re-assessments to track improvement between engagements.

Who it’s for

  • Organizations entering a compliance assessment or renewal cycle.
  • Leadership teams that need an objective view of security risk.
  • Buyers evaluating nTrust.ai automation after an independent baseline.
  • Teams adopting AI systems that must demonstrate NIST AI RMF alignment.

Compliance alignment

Every nTrust solution is engineered with enterprise-grade security from day one and maps to the frameworks your organization operates under:

  • NIST AI RMF (Govern, Map, Measure, Manage)
  • EU AI Act transparency & logging obligations
  • ISO 27001 and SOC 2 control alignment
  • GDPR and CCPA privacy requirements
